select id, gmt_create, gmt_modified, create_user, update_user, is_deleted, status, username, user_no, current_role_code, real_name, mobile, remark, sort from sys_user where is_deleted = false
and username like concat('%', #{query.username}, '%')
and real_name like concat('%', #{query.realName}, '%')
and mobile like concat('%', #{query.mobile}, '%')
and status = #{query.status}
order by sort asc, id asc
